Exact selectable routes

A book's own title is printed where it can be opened — inside the reader, out of the ledger, with the records behind it. This page names a built book as it is commonly read, and names everything not yet built by its recorded id alone, exactly as the bridge carries it — some ids hold the work's own Hebrew title, and that is the record showing, not this page translating. The Hebrew of each built book carries its own license, named on the page it is read from and in anything exported from it.
